dict.string: Cognify Notch reads your location once, only when you press Detect location, to find your city for weather and sun times. It stays on this Mac.
Cognify Notch reads your location once, only when you press Detect location, to find your city for weather and sun times. It stays on this Mac.
The camera is only used for the Mirror in the notch. Nothing is recorded or saved.
Playing audio is only used to move the equalizer in the notch. It is not recorded, saved, or sent.
The microphone is only used when you press record in quick notes or Test mic on the Camera & Mic page. Nothing is saved or sent.
Your voice recording is turned into note text. It is all processed on this Mac and never sent to the internet.
Scheduled reminders are shown in Agenda. If To-do sync is on, tasks from the notch are also saved to your default Reminders list. Nothing is sent anywhere.
